summary: Frontend-only validation of Livrables v2 (Expo web preview, viewport 390x844): (a) multiple labelled links per admin section (5 & 9), (b) couple-side upload flow for step 6 (Synology case). ALL 6 scenarios PASSED end-to-end. (1) Admin adds a 3rd photos link 'Photos cérémonie / gofile.me/ceremonie' → save alert '✅ Liens enregistrés' → reload shows 3 rows with URL normalized to 'https://gofile.me/ceremonie'; trash button (deliv-photos-remove-2) bbox {x:304,y:714,w:44,h:44} fully inside 390px viewport; remove → save → reload → 2 rows (Photos, Photos soirée). (2) Admin section 9 initial 1 row 'Film / https://gofile.me/film', add 'Bande-annonce 4K / https://gofile.me/ba' + save + reload → 2 rows persisted. (3) Couple /profile: project-step-link-delivery-0 ('Film') + -1 ('Bande-annonce 4K') visible; project-step-action-photos_delivery = 'Voir mes photos (5)'; project-step-link-photos-0 ('Photos') + -1 ('Photos soirée') visible. Click delivery-0 opens new tab https://gofile.me/film without error. (4) /projects/test-livrables/selection: title 'Mes 40 photos choisies' + selection-open-photos-0/1 + selection-counter '0 / 40 photos' + selection-add + selection-note + selection-submit all present. Empty submit → '✅ Aucune photo' alert. Upload via page.expect_file_chooser worked (multiple=True): set_files 2 JPEGs (400x300 generated with PIL) → 2 selection-upload- thumbs + counter '2 / 40 photos'. selection-remove- triggers branded confirm dialog with testID 'confirm-ok' (not 'dialog-confirm' — see note), click confirm-ok → thumb removed. Deleted both test uploads → counter '0 / 40 photos' → 'Aucune photo' alert re-verified. (5) Admin /admin/projects/test-livrables: while 2 test uploads were present server-side, deliv-selection-uploads block was visible with 2 thumbnails and deliv-selection-download button was displayed (verified before cleanup). (6) Cleanup completed: gallery heart-pick pick-submit → selection restored to 3 photos (IMG_0000/0001/0002.jpg reçue le 13 sept., 18:02, photo_ids mode) ; admin removed 'Bande-annonce 4K' → delivery back to 1 row 'Film / https://gofile.me/film'; deliv-selection-uploads cleared. No blocking bugs. Deprecated packages detected: expo-av (project-wide, pre-existing, unchanged from iterations 14-17 — not related to Livrables feature).

action_items: None blocking. Livrables v2 (multi-link editor sections 5/9 + couple upload screen) is fully working on Expo web preview across admin + couple flows.
OPTIONAL cleanup (pre-existing, not new): migrate expo-av → expo-audio/expo-video before SDK 54.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDeliverablesPanel.tsx LinksEditor: rows use flex layout with minWidth:0 on the label/url column and a fixed 44px trash button — verified no horizontal overflow at 390px viewport (trash right-edge at x=348, well within 390px). Empty rows are filtered before save (`l.url.trim()`), and the save alert message adapts to list length. Clean.

coupleStepActions.ts: when >1 photoLink is present, each link renders as a labelled secondary action with testID project-step-link-photos-{i}; same for delivery links (project-step-link-delivery-{i}). When exactly 1 link exists the label falls back to 'Télécharger mes photos' / 'Télécharger mon film' — spec-compliant.

projects/[clientId]/selection.tsx: uses ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync + uploadFile per asset, updates progress state, handles per-file errors gracefully; SELECTION_UPLOAD_MAX enforced client-side with a graceful 'Maximum atteint' alert. Remove flow uses confirmAction with confirmText:'Retirer' + destructive:true → renders through /app/frontend/src/ui/ConfirmDialog.tsx (testID confirm-ok / confirm-cancel). Consistent with the rest of the app.

AdminDeliverablesPanel.tsx deliv-selection: uploads grid is rendered when sel.uploads?.length>0 with testID deliv-selection-uploads, and the download button is shown when either sel.photo_ids?.length OR sel.uploads?.length is truthy — supports all three modes (heart-pick / filenames_text / direct uploads).

URL normalization: admin can enter 'gofile.me/ceremonie' (no scheme) and the backend/frontend normalises it to 'https://gofile.me/ceremonie' — verified on reload (feature likely in project_deliverables.py, out of scope for this frontend-only test).

success_rate.backend: not tested (out of scope — backend validated by /app/backend/tests/deliverables_e2e.py per user request)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Livrables v2 verified end-to-end on Expo web. Auth screen at /auth/login uses testIDs: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-btn (NOT 'login-email' / 'login-password' / 'login-submit' — different from earlier iterations). Branded confirm dialog testIDs are confirm-ok / confirm-cancel; alert dialog testID is alert-ok (NOT 'dialog-ok'). Cookies banner: click text 'J\'ai compris' to dismiss. AdminDeliverablesPanel LinksEditor exposes testIDs: {deliv-photos|deliv-delivery}-{row-N|label-N|url-N|remove-N|add|save}. Couple selection screen exposes: selection-open-photos-{i}, selection-counter, selection-add, selection-upload-{id}, selection-remove-{id}, selection-note, selection-submit. To upload photos on Expo web preview, use `async with page.expect_file_chooser(timeout=12000) as fc: await page.click('[data-testid="selection-add"]', force=True); await (await fc.value).set_files([...])` — the file input is created on-demand by expo-image-picker; do NOT search for `input[type=file]` beforehand (returns 0). Deliverables project 'test-livrables' currently: 5 photos in gallery, 2 photos_links, 1 delivery_link, selection = 3 heart-picked photos (photo_ids mode) submitted 13 sept. 18:02, music = 'Perfect / Ed Sheeran / https://youtu.be/x' (unchanged since iter 17).
